title: Commando 3
desc: Commando Karan Singh Dogra and Inspector Bhavna Reddy race against time to thwart a terrorist attack on India. Later, they realise that foiling mastermind Buraq's plan is harder than it seems.

title: Om Bheem Bush
desc: Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: Karan Arjun
desc: Karan and Arjun, two brothers driven by revenge, are murdered by their uncle while seeking justice for their father's death. However, they resurrect years later to settle their unfinished score.

title: Dream Girl
desc: A man lands a call center job by mimicking a woman's voice, gaining fame and a loyal fan base. However, his double life spirals out of control when rabid clients overstep boundaries.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest police officer, is tasked with curbing Tezpur's rampant crime rates. Here he must work with his fellow corrupt officers and deal with the town's insidious political figures.

title: Crook
desc: After his uncle catches him selling pirated DVDs, Jai Dixit is sent to Australia with a new identity. However, whilst falling in love with a woman, he assumes yet another identity to pursue her.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Friends Kabir, Imran and Arjun take a vacation in Spain before Kabir's marriage. The trip turns into an opportunity to mend fences, heal wounds, fall in love with life and combat their worst fears.

title: Rashmi Rocket
desc: A small-town girl overcomes all societal barriers to become a national-level athlete, but her glory is meaningless when she must undergo a gender test.

title: Lingaa
desc: Lingaa, a petty thief, turns over a new leaf after realising the role his grandfather has played in building a dam for the villagers. He then dedicates his life to saving it from a corrupt minister.

title: Khiladi 786
desc: A father who runs a matrimonial agency believes that his son is a failure in life. To prove him wrong, the son takes on the task of finding a match for a gangster's sister.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Ab Tumhare Hawale Watan Saathiyo
desc: Kunal falls in love with Shweta and decides to stay in the army to get close to her but soon finds out that she is waiting for her husband Rajeev to return from war.

title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
desc: Two individuals discover their identities and develop affection, yet domestic obligations strain their bond. Consequently, they part ways while anticipating an eventual reunion.

title: Antim: The Final Truth
desc: Rahul runs away from his poverty-stricken village life to become a gangster in the city. There, he locks horns with an upstanding policeman who tries to set him on the right path.
